principle_violations.reason: The `Order` class handles both order management (adding items, calculating total price) and payment processing, violating the Single Responsibility Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the payment processing logic into a dedicated class, such as `PaymentProcessor`, to adhere to the Single Responsibility Principle.

principle_violations.reason: The `pay` method needs to be modified for adding new payment types, violating the Open/Closed Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Utilize a strategy pattern for payment processing where new payment methods can be added without modifying existing code.
